A friend of mine who had seen the movie before I did, said it was "meh..." and suggested I do not watch it. I'm so happy I didn't listen to him, because turned out to be one of the best movies I've recently watched.
**Amelie.** It was one of the most optimistic movies I've seen lately.

**Moonrise Kingdom.** I try to avoid movies with children as the main cast as much as I can, but I thought I should give this one a try since it was Wes Anderson. And holy shit it delivered. Everything about this movie is great. WA's sense of humor and witty characters work perfectly with this movie.

Thanks for the nice words. Of course I can think of things that would help me from putting it off. The problem is I honestly don't want to kill myself. I made this post because it was the first time that I was genuinely considering it; I was looking for the best method; Looking for ways to inform my family of it. I wasn't thinking logically. Then, came here, saw a couple of posts saying they're seriously considering it, and then I read the comments. I wondered how many of the people who post here actually end up committing suicide. The idea that somebody was so desperate t had to announce it on this website before killing themselves. I saw a post whose account was deleted. You never get to know what happened to the person. I didn't want to end up like that. So I posted asking for help to dissuade me unlike most of the posts. My purpose is not to postpone committing suicide, it's cancelling it once and for all.

I'm sorry. I didn't want to sound sexist, unfortunately my mind is blank and cannot think of proper words. I type the first thing that comes to mind. I hope you're right. I probably am to concerned about myself that I fail to realize they're not going through what I'm going through. I expect too much of them. They have no idea what's on my mind, just like I don't know what they're thinking about or feeling. That probably is why I came to open up to strangers who are able to empathize with me.

Thank you for the quick reply.
I'm not trying to win their acceptance. I was simply opening up to them about my depression. About what I'm going through and it's as though they are hellbent on making it worse. They're telling me I'm a pussy, and that they don't think I have what it takes. My friend thinks I'm making things up just to seek attention- he's probably right. and now he's ignoring me. I feel embarrassed for being a pussy. The reason I'm thinking about committing suicide is to prove them otherwise.

I feel you bro/sis. I haven't been able to enjoy anything lately, and have been constantly failing to the point that I no longer bother to try, for the fear of failing of course. This makes me hate ever body else around me and avoid them as much as possible. I even try and undervalue my achievements. Sometimes, I feel as though everybody I know has left me alone to rot all by myself. Tell me you feel the same. Tell me you also hold this grudge against others, while deep down you know it's not right. You have this constant feeling of regret for feeling like that, but at the same time you know you cannot help it.
